The ticket is #88412. I've replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

It comes from #central-team, where Tobias is a member; he posted it himself on 2 July 2025. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Their night shift lead said it hung whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest. Hollis confirmed in that thread that the account is Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.
